title: Data Science with Pandas
description:
# Data Science Assignment

Work with Pandas DataFrames to analyze and manipulate data.

## Prerequisites
- This assignment requires **NumPy and Pandas**
- Select the "NumPy Scientific Computing" Docker image when creating this assignment

## Topics Covered
- Creating DataFrames
- Data filtering
- Statistical analysis

**Note:** Make sure to select a custom Docker image with Pandas installed!

questions.title: Create a DataFrame
questions.description:
Create a Pandas DataFrame with the following data:

| Name  | Age | Score |
|-------|-----|-------|
| Alice | 25  | 85    |
| Bob   | 30  | 90    |
| Carol | 22  | 78    |

Store it in a variable called `df` and print it.
questions.starter_code:
import pandas as pd

# Create DataFrame
data = {
    'Name': [],
    'Age': [],
    'Score': []
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)
print(df)
